stem: By using transmitters to track the fish in the Yangtze River, researchers most likely will be able to —

options.label: A
options.text: monitor the number of fish living in the river basin

options.label: B
options.text: estimate how many fish are needed to sustain the population

options.label: C
options.text: determine how changes to the river disrupt the life cycle of the fish

options.label: D
options.text: learn which types of fish are preferred by the fishing industry in the surrounding cities
